premises.scope: Completed D5: every original-coordinate cross block M satisfies ||p_Q||inf <= 5 sqrt(2e) e5(M^T M)^(-1/10), no marginal condition.
Completed localized Theorem A: physical principal 3x3 block with eigenvalue moduli >=c pays full ambient density by 6 sqrt(pi)/c after original-coordinate conditioning.

designated_partner.actual_use: Used as the current stronger aggregate-third-volume/rank-eight comparison endpoint. This run replaces its third-volume route by an unconditional D5/V1 telescoping route, obtaining rank<=16 without dependence on projected-crossing chronology.

results.statement: For slab ratio rho>2+6sqrt(pi), every target-class A admits A=D+R+E with D diagonal, rank R<=16, E symmetric zero-diagonal, and ||E||F<=K*/rho, K*=3*120^(1/4)*(4^5*(5sqrt(2e))^10)^(1/8)=508.73821835096095... . Uses V5<=4^5(5sqrt(2e))^10 rho^-10 and V1>=rho^-2.
There are target-class A_R=A0+E_R and finite-union unit-indicator product laws with ||E_R||F->0 but |X^T E_R X|->2 uniformly, so the residual cannot be deleted from coefficient norm alone.

If a diverging counterexample sequence exists, after arbitrarily small slab-ratio loss it may be taken with bounded finite-union unit-product indicators and A_m=D_m+R_m+E_m, rank R_m<=16, ||E_m||F=O(rho_m^-1), while V5(A_m)=O(rho_m^-10).

next_step: Fresnel-linearize only the bounded-rank carrier and combine pinned twisted one-dimensional Lp bounds on original product coordinates with a graph/partition treatment of the zero-diagonal twist; any estimate must survive the separated two-fragment nonperturbation family.
